claims.text: UPI Lite is designed to process small transactions of Rs. 500 or less without a UPI PIN, provided the user has enabled the feature and the app includes passcode, biometrics, or pattern locks.
claims.original_text: UPI Lite is designed to process small transactions of Rs. 500 or less without a UPI PIN, provided the user has enabled the feature and the app includes passcode, biometrics, or pattern locks (S1).

claims.text: UPI Tap & Pay enables contactless NFC-based payments by tapping an unlocked mobile device on a PoS terminal or QR tag, extending beyond QR scanning to include Point of Sale terminals.
claims.original_text: UPI Tap & Pay enables contactless NFC-based payments by tapping an unlocked mobile device on a PoS terminal or QR tag, extending beyond QR scanning to include Point of Sale terminals (S8).
